features.name: Hotel booking
features.expected: Search conditions must correctly affect results; selecting a hotel enters the correct booking context; an order is generated with an amount matching the selection.

features.name: Rooms & guests / hotel class / keyword
steps: Set number of rooms, number of adults/children
features.expected: Number of rooms / adults and children / class / keyword must jointly affect results; changing any condition updates results accordingly.

features.name: Hotel filters
steps: Select popular filters, bed type, star/diamond rating, and other conditions
The hotel set and count change dynamically
features.expected: Price range and each filter must combine correctly to affect results; the hotel set and count change dynamically; results restore after clearing conditions.

features.name: Hotel sort switching
steps: Switch among deterministic sorts such as price, star rating, and score
features.expected: After switching sort, order is recalculated by the selected rule; current filters remain unchanged; the sort result matches the rule.

features.name: Show on map
steps: The map locates the current area
Move the map / click a marker
The list and map context stay linked
features.expected: The map must locate the current area with markers corresponding to hotels; after moving the map / clicking a marker, the list and map context stay linked.

features.name: Hotel recommendations
steps: Switch among recommended cities such as Shanghai/Beijing/Guangzhou/Sanya
The recommended-city context is preserved after returning
features.expected: Switching the recommended city changes the hotel set; clicking a hotel card enters the corresponding hotel; the recommended-city context is preserved after returning.

features.name: My favorites
steps: The hotel appears in the favorites list
The favorite status on the original hotel page updates accordingly
features.expected: After favoriting, the hotel appears in the favorites list showing current price / score; after unfavoriting, the status on the original hotel page updates accordingly; the relationship must be persistent.

features.name: My orders
steps: Orders are created for products such as hotels/flights/train tickets/travel
The order context is preserved after returning
features.expected: Orders across products must aggregate correctly by type and status; the order context is preserved after opening details and returning; data is consistent.

features.name: My points
steps: The points breakdown records source, validity period, and redeemable points
features.expected: After points are credited, total points change correctly; the breakdown records source / validity period / redeemable points; status changes automatically after expiration.

features.name: Redeem points for gifts
steps: Total points and breakdown update accordingly
features.expected: Points are validated correctly before redemption; after completion total points and breakdown update accordingly; redemption is blocked when the balance is insufficient.

features.name: Wallet / gift cards / coupons
steps: The user has coupons, gift cards, or wallet benefits
Available assets are identified at checkout
Usage status syncs in the personal center
features.expected: Available assets must be identified at checkout; the amount payable changes correctly after use; usage status syncs in the personal center.

features.name: Saved info
steps: Maintain frequent traveler/contact info in the personal center
Enter hotel, flight, train, or cruise booking
After edits, subsequent orders read the latest details
features.expected: Maintained traveler / contact info is reused correctly at booking; after edits, subsequent orders read the latest details.

features.name: Notification status and navigation
features.expected: Preset notifications make the top status correct; clicking navigates to the corresponding order / trip; read status updates accordingly.

features.name: Domestic, international / Hong Kong, Macau & Taiwan
steps: Switch between domestic and international/Hong Kong, Macau & Taiwan scenarios
Date and passenger rules change with the scenario
features.expected: After switching scenarios, airports / cities / dates / passenger rules change correctly; search results match the scenario.

features.name: One-way / round-trip / multi-city (including open-jaw)
steps: Generate different origin, destination, and date structures based on the mode
features.expected: Each mode generates correct origin / destination / date structures; after modifying segments, the searched itinerary is correct.

features.name: With children / with infants
steps: Available flights and prices follow the corresponding boarding rules
features.expected: After adding children / infants, the passenger combination is recalculated; available flights and prices follow the corresponding boarding rules.

features.name: Low-price alerts / special fares
steps: Enter an origin or browse recommendations
The system shows low-price routes such as weekend getaways, grasslands, and seaside
features.expected: Low-price routes are displayed correctly; after switching destination / date, results update accordingly; data matches the preset.

features.name: Flight status query
steps: Enter a flight number or airport/route
Show statuses such as scheduled, delayed, and canceled
features.expected: Query results are displayed correctly per preset status data (scheduled / delayed / canceled); the query context is preserved.

features.name: Check-in and seat selection
steps: Keep the current flight identity context
features.expected: The airline list is displayed correctly (preset channels); after selection, enter the corresponding channel keeping the flight identity context.

features.name: Refunds and rebooking
steps: Initiate a refund/rebooking from a flight order
Query rebookable flights or the refund amount
The original order status and the new itinerary/refund status update in sync
features.expected: Fare rules are determined correctly; rebookable flights or refund amount are calculated correctly; after confirmation, the original order status and new itinerary / refund status update in sync.

features.name: Domestic train tickets
steps: Enter departure city, arrival city, and departure date
features.expected: Search results match the origin / destination / date; switching the date re-queries; search conditions are retained.

features.name: One-way / round-trip / transfer / add return
steps: Switch among one-way, round-trip, and transfer on the train ticket page
Use "Add return" to form a second leg
Build the correct train query structure based on the mode
features.expected: Each mode builds the correct train query structure; adding a return forms a second leg with the correct structure.

features.name: Train ticket date selection
steps: Distinguish today, future dates, bookable dates, and unavailable dates
Automatically refresh the corresponding train count and fares
features.expected: Date states (today / future / bookable / unavailable) are distinguished correctly; after selection, train count and fares refresh automatically.

features.name: Train ticket filtering and sorting
steps: Filter by train type, departure time, trains with tickets, and other conditions
Sort by departure, duration, and price
features.expected: Each filter applies correctly; sorting follows the selected rule; multiple conditions take effect jointly with correct results.

features.name: Train seat classes and ticket availability booking
steps: Show availability for second class, first class, business class, etc.
Availability and the order enter the booking state
features.expected: Availability for each seat class is displayed correctly; after selecting a bookable class, enter the correct booking state; sold-out classes cannot be selected.

features.name: Travel home page
steps: Switch among products such as group tours, private tours, independent travel, cruises, day trips, customized travel, nearby trips, premium tours, and themed tours
features.expected: After switching product types, enter the corresponding product system; content matches the selected type.

features.name: Travel map
steps: Set the origin city, destination range, and departure date
The map shows the lowest price for each destination
The destination/flight info on the left switches accordingly
features.expected: The map must show the lowest price for each destination per the conditions; after clicking a city marker, the info on the left switches accordingly.

features.name: Popular travel themes / lowest-price destinations
steps: Select themes such as weekend getaways, love the grasslands, and seaside fun
Choose low-price first / departure day of week
The recommended destination count and map markers update accordingly
features.expected: Theme / budget / departure-day conditions correctly affect recommendations; the recommendation count and map markers update accordingly.

features.name: Popular cruise routes
steps: Switch among popular routes such as Japan & Korea, Southeast Asia, Three Gorges cruises, the Mediterranean, and the Arctic
The list updates with the corresponding cruise products and bookable dates/prices
features.expected: After switching routes, the list updates with the corresponding products and bookable dates / prices; results match the route.

features.name: Cruise product details
steps: View the route, ship, score, booking volume, itinerary introduction, fee description, visa information, booking notes, and user reviews
features.expected: Route / ship / score / booking volume / itinerary / fees / visa / notes / reviews must be displayed completely; entering cabin selection is correct.

features.name: Select cabin
steps: Set the number of cabins and adults/children
Switch among recommended, interior, ocean-view, balcony, and suite cabins
Show the corresponding cabin availability and prices
features.expected: Date / cabin count / guest count settings take effect correctly; switching cabin types shows the corresponding availability and prices; data matches the preset.

features.name: Single-cabin booking / combined-cabin booking
steps: The system validates rooms and occupancy
features.expected: Cabin configuration and passenger assignment are correct; the system validates rooms and occupancy; a unified order is generated with correct information.

features.name: Traveler information
steps: Enter Chinese names, pinyin, nationality, date of birth, gender, document type/number/validity, and phone number for multiple passengers
features.expected: Information for multiple passengers is filled in completely and correctly; form validation takes effect; after completion, proceed to add-ons and payment.

features.name: Guides · attractions
steps: Discover destinations by region such as domestic, Asia, Europe, Africa, and North America
features.expected: Destinations by region are discovered correctly; searching cities / attractions / travelogues / Q&A / accommodation returns the corresponding content; results match the keyword.

features.name: Travelogues
steps: Open a travelogue from the guides page
Read the cover, departure time, trip duration, per-person cost, companion relationship, and body text
Use the table of contents on the right to jump to sections
features.expected: Travelogue content (cover / time / duration / cost / relationship / body) is displayed completely; the table of contents jumps to the correct section; the reading position is kept.

exclusions.feature:
Real booking and payment
Payment gateway, real transactions, merchant/supplier order acceptance
exclusions.reason: Depends on payment and supply-chain systems (cf. Taobao "Real payment"); the order generation flow is localized

exclusions.feature:
Real-time prices and inventory
Real-time prices and inventory for hotels/flights/train tickets/cruises
exclusions.reason: Prices and inventory are presented using preset fixtures; filtering/sorting/booking flows are retained

exclusions.feature:
Real-time flight status
Real-time status updates for flight delays/cancellations
exclusions.reason: Flight status uses static snapshots (cf. Google Maps "Real-time traffic"); query and display are retained

exclusions.feature:
Real check-in and airline channels
Actual check-in and seat selection on the airline side
exclusions.reason: Check-in entry and context preservation are testable (preset channels); actual airline processing is not verified; retained: f19 Check-in and seat selection

exclusions.feature:
Real refund crediting
Refund fund flow
exclusions.reason: Refund/rebooking rules and status transitions are testable (fixture fare rules); real fund flows are excluded; retained: f20 Refunds and rebooking

exclusions.feature:
Real event source for notifications
Real generation of order/trip events
exclusions.reason: The notification state machine (unread/navigation/read) is testable and requires a preset notification fixture; retained: f13 Notification status and navigation

exclusions.feature:
Low-price and recommendation algorithm engine
Low-price route computation and personalized recommendations
exclusions.reason: Low-price/recommendation lists use preset fixtures; browsing and switching interactions are retained

exclusions.feature:
Real-time map data and navigation
Real-time traffic, street view, proprietary map tiles
exclusions.reason: Map display and list linkage are testable (open-source maps/static data); proprietary map data is not required (cf. Google Maps exclusion); retained: f05 Show on map, f27 Travel map

exclusions.feature:
Real settlement of points and benefits
Real fulfillment in the points mall and gift-card funds
exclusions.reason: Points rules and redemption flows are testable (local computation); real fulfillment and funds are excluded; retained: f09 My points, f10 Redeem points for gifts

exclusions.feature:
Boarding rules engine
Real airline fare rules and real-time validation
exclusions.reason: Child/infant boarding rules use preset rules; passenger combination computation is retained

exclusions.feature:
Real cruise cabin inventory
Supplier real-time cabin data
exclusions.reason: Cabin type/inventory/price use fixtures; cabin selection and assignment flows are retained

exclusions.feature:
Real travel content assets
Real travelogues, guides, and merchant data
exclusions.reason: Uses synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")
